name: run_sandboxes

test_list.description: Excess requests wait for permits; observed create/exec/destroy activity never exceeds the configured cap.
Every successful or failed cycle destroys its owned identity, releases its journal only after confirmed destruction, and leaves no journal entries.
Create and exec faults are reported with their cycle and stage; preexisting identities are never destroyed.
Each attempted creation has a measured latency, with no fabricated timings.
The live evidence parser requires MemTotal, MemAvailable, SwapTotal and SwapFree in kB, rejecting malformed, duplicate, impossible and wrong-unit fields.

Opt-in actual OpenShell test refuses creation unless Linux MemTotal is within 512 MiB below 6 GiB, samples peak used memory and swap through all 100 cycles, and records create-latency quantiles with exact operation and zero-leak assertions.

inputs.name: limits
inputs.description: Bounded concurrency, repetitions and operation deadlines.

inputs.name: POLARIS_OPEN_SHELL_ENDPOINT
inputs.description: Explicit HTTPS gateway endpoint; defaults to the standard local WSL2 endpoint.

output_description: Actual cycle counts, peak activity, failures, create timings, remaining owned journal identities, and live-only JSON memory and create-latency evidence.
